title: 亚马逊十年大单：目标600亿美元，高通数据中心能否翻身？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Give me a sense here as exactly why and what this deal actually tells us about Qualcomm's attempt to kind of break a deeper into the AI data center market.
segments.zh: 请介绍一下，这笔交易究竟说明了什么？高通在AI数据中心市场寻求更深突破。

segments.en: Yeah, Romain, first of all, thanks for having me here. Great to be here.
segments.zh: 罗曼，首先感谢你的邀请，很高兴来到这里。

segments.en: We're very excited about this deal. This is a long-term strategic engagement between Amazon and Qualcomm.
segments.zh: 我们对这笔交易非常兴奋，这是亚马逊和高通之间的长期战略合作。

segments.en: And it becomes one of the foundation deals for our data center business going forward.
segments.zh: 这将成为我们数据中心业务未来发展的基础交易之一。

segments.en: What we announced today is we're going to engage in multiple generations of custom chip engagement between Qualcomm and Amazon.
segments.zh: 今天宣布的是，高通和亚马逊将开展多代定制芯片合作。

segments.en: We are also going to supply multiple generation of optical connectivity solutions to them.
segments.zh: 我们还将为他们提供多代光连接解决方案。

segments.en: And as a part of this, we're looking at a transaction that is a long-term target of $60 billion in revenue
segments.zh: 作为其中一部分，我们预计长期交易收入目标为600亿美元。

segments.en: over the next 10 years and very sure in warrants against it. So very excited that this is going to be one of the ways we're going to develop our data center business.
segments.zh: 未来十年内，我们对此非常有信心。这是发展数据中心业务的重要途径。

segments.en: And it gives us very high confidence in achieving the 2027 revenue forecast that we put in front of investors a couple months ago.
segments.zh: 这让我们对实现2027年营收预测非常有信心，该预测是几个月前向市场参与者公布的。

segments.en: And also growing, delivering strong growth in 2028 beyond what we had previously expected.
segments.zh: 同时，2028年也将实现强劲增长，超出我们之前的预期。

segments.en: So overall, great day for us and great opportunity for us here.
segments.zh: 所以总的来说，这对我们来说是美好的一天，也是巨大的机遇。

segments.en: Just real quickly, though, give me a sense here of why you chose to sort of issue the warrants against it.
segments.zh: 不过，请简单告诉我，你们为什么选择发行认股权证？

segments.en: What was the thinking behind that? Yeah, I think we're looking at the value that this deal is going to bring to Qualcomm.
segments.zh: 背后的考量是什么？我认为我们看重的是这笔交易将为高通带来的价值。

segments.en: Obviously, it's a very large transaction.
segments.zh: 显然，这是一笔非常大的交易。
